name: OKF Knowledge Base
description: A general-purpose, agent-managed knowledge base stored as OKF bundles (Markdown + YAML frontmatter). Maintains a two-level derived index (bundle concept index + per-document TOC), serves deterministic concept-anchored search, auto-triggers ingest runs in a bundled least-privilege sub-agent and tracks them as jobs (cancellable and deletable), and exposes 21 okf_* tools natively to the BOS assistant plus a loopback REST bridge for the standalone OKF Knowledge Base app.

toolGroups.name: Knowledge Base
toolGroups.description: A durable, human-readable knowledge base of OKF bundles: concept-anchored search over a derived index, full-document / full-chapter retrieval, ingesting sources into chapters, curating the concept vocabulary, linking, health checks, and importing or exporting bundles.

bundleRoot.description: Absolute BOS VFS path (e.g. /KnowledgeBase, visible in the Files app) under which OKF bundles (directories of Markdown + YAML frontmatter) are stored.

port.description: HTTP port for the loopback REST bridge the OKF Knowledge Base app talks to. 0 lets the OS assign one automatically (recommended — never give this a fixed non-zero default).

maxDepth.description: Ingest reference-crawl depth: how many hops of references to follow beyond the seed source. 0 = seed source only. Overridable per okf_ingest call.

maxWorkers.description: How many references an ingest run ingests concurrently. Overridable per okf_ingest call.

maxChunkSize.description: Maximum size, in characters, of one ingest chunk. When okf_add_raw_source registers a source larger than this it mechanically pre-splits it (heading → paragraph → sentence boundaries) into .chunks/<docId>/NNN.md and returns the chunk paths, so the ingest agent reads one bounded chunk at a time instead of the whole document. Default 32000 (~8K tokens).

staleJobMs.description: How long (ms) an ingest job may sit queued or running before the reaper marks it failed(stale). The launcher writes a terminal state for every run it watches, so this only catches runs orphaned by a service or BOS restart. Default 1800000 (30 minutes) — comfortably longer than a real run.
